info.title: DevTools Hub Public API
info.description: Public read-only surface for DevTools Hub (https://tools.scoreroute.com): the full tool catalog, AI-discovery endpoints, and feedback/admin listing. AI agents and crawlers: prefer `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` for the markdown tool catalog; this OpenAPI document describes the JSON surfaces.

license.name: MIT (this document); tools themselves are MIT-licensed client-side JavaScript

get.description: Returns the complete tool catalog as JSON. Mirrors what the homepage, /tools/ index, and per-category pages render. Source of truth: /manifest.txt. Regenerated by scripts/regen-agent-skills.sh.

200.description: JSON object with keys: `tools` (array of {slug, name, desc, tags, category, categoryLabel, featured, isnew, url}), `categories` (object mapping category slug to human label).

get.summary: List user comments for a tool (requires slug query param)

200.description: Array of approved comments with id, slug, name, content, rating, timestamp

get.description: Returns the full feedback KV. Used by the admin to review and triage.

200.description: Array of feedback entries with id, category, tool, type, description, timestamp, resolved

get.description: Per the llmstxt.org spec — markdown index of the site for AI agents.
Verbose version of /llms.txt with one entry per tool.

200.description: JSON: { name, description, version, homepage, tool_count, categories, llms_txt, llms_full_txt, sitemap, tools[] }
JSON describing the MCP server surface

get.summary: Sitemap listing all HTML + markdown URLs

200.description: application/xml; 333 tools × {html, .md} + 11 category pages × {html, .md} + static pages.
